title: agent-crew run session registry
description: Session-level state for one crew:run invocation (including any task-injection extensions). Lives at {STATE_DIR}/session.json. Written by crew:run Step 4 and Step 1.5 injection path. additionalProperties is true so future B-phase / C-phase task fields remain forward-compatible.

schema_version.description: Optional in v1. Pre-F4 session.json files do not have this field; validators tolerate absence.

session_id.description: {YYYYMMDD}-{HHMMSS}. Generated by the original (non-injecting) orchestrator at Step 4.

pre_run_head.description: Git SHA of the pre-run HEAD. Optional — older session.json files may omit it. Used by crew:status --collect for diff stat.

task_hash.description: Phase B0 — normalized form of task. Pre-B0 entries omit this field; consumers treat missing as 'cannot dedupe'.

injected.description: True when the task was added via the run.md Step 1.5 injection path.
